data.name: Vimalraj
data.gender_notes: Vimalraj is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Vimalraj is recorded with the meaning “Pure King”. Vimalraj is a Hindu name meaning “Pure King”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses. Note: this meaning has not been independently verified against a classical lexicon or primary source and is flagged for source verification.

in_sanskrit.name: Vimalraj
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who rules with purity and is free from impurities

in_hindi.name: विमलराज
in_hindi.long_meaning: जो शुद्धि से होता है वह राजा

in_tamil.name: விமல்ராஜ
in_tamil.long_meaning: பதுவேகம் அதுவம் பிரமம் அளவியிடம் இருக்கிற ராஜா

in_marathi.name: Vimalraj
in_marathi.long_meaning: Vimalraj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who is free from all impurities and vices, and is a just and virtuous ruler.

in_bengali.name: Vimalraj
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Pure King
in_bengali.long_meaning: Vimalraj একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। One who is free from all impurities and vices, and is a just and virtuous ruler.
